results.name: diagnosticSetting
results.reason: Current 2021-05-01-preview schema matches the declared fields. Latest GA 2016-09-01 cannot preserve this configuration: its REST route is the fixed /diagnosticSettings/service path, it has no logAnalyticsDestinationType property, and its inherited Resource requires location while the current 2021 preview removed location and this source omits it.
results.migration: Not feasible without changing behavior or resource shape: current uses custom name aks-control-plane-basic and logAnalyticsDestinationType=Dedicated; GA 2016-09-01 has a fixed service route and no Dedicated destination property, and requires location.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: Original Bicep /name maps to current preview route parameter {name}:string; literal aks-control-plane-basic is valid as a name string. GA candidate route is fixed to /diagnosticSettings/service and cannot preserve this custom name.

usage.label: scope

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: Original /properties maps to DiagnosticSettings. Current preview has workspaceId, logAnalyticsDestinationType, and logs fields; GA has only workspaceId/logs and other sink fields, lacking logAnalyticsDestinationType.

usage.label: workspaceId
usage.analysis: REST properties.workspaceId is a string ARM resource ID in both current preview and GA; source string parameter supplies that value.

usage.label: logAnalyticsDestinationType
usage.analysis: Current preview schema defines this as string, and Learn documents Dedicated as an allowed value; literal 'Dedicated' is valid. The 2016-09-01 GA model omits this property entirely, so the chosen dedicated-table behavior cannot migrate unchanged.

current.analysis: Exact Learn current page and pinned preview diagnosticsSettings_API.json were read. PUT route includes /diagnosticSettings/{name}; DiagnosticSettings has workspaceId:string, logs array, and logAnalyticsDestinationType:string. Learn says Dedicated is an allowed value. LogSettings.category is string and enabled:boolean is required. Current source values match this schema.

ga.analysis: Learn selector shows latest stable GA 2016-09-01; fixed REST tree has stable serviceDiagnosticsSettings schemas at 2015-07-01 and 2016-09-01. Exact candidate route is fixed at /diagnosticSettings/service, ServiceDiagnosticSettings omits logAnalyticsDestinationType, and inherited Resource requires location. This source uses a custom name and Dedicated and omits location, so candidate is not behaviorally compatible.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log for 2021-05-01-preview says the preview resource removed location and added systemData; current source omits location as permitted by the preview schema. Comparing current preview with stable GA shows the older GA requires location, uses the fixed service route, and lacks logAnalyticsDestinationType. The preview-only dedicated-table behavior and custom name are retained; no implicit downgrade is made.
